title: Strix Llama
subtitle: Local model management
backendHint: Selected in config/jan/backend.json. Reload the model to switch.

notice.loading: Loading the model. Progress appears in the developer log.
notice.sharedVramFallback: The dedicated carve ran out, so the model was loaded again in shared memory. This is slower than fitting entirely in dedicated memory.
notice.saved: Settings saved. The running instance keeps its parameters; they apply on the next load.
notice.headMerged: Draft head combined with the shared draft: {{files}}. It is now the preferred draft.

models.rootsHelp: One local model directory per line
models.empty: No matching models. Adjust the directories or the search.

runtime.note: Sparse attention and Flash Attention are always on for this architecture; turning either off runs out of memory above 64K context. Weights are used as quantised in the file.

generation.title: Generation
generation.thinkingNote: This model's template accepts low, medium and xhigh only, and folds “high” into xhigh — so there is no fifth level to offer. A single request can override this with chat_template_kwargs.

thinkingHelp.off: The model answers directly, with no reasoning step.
thinkingHelp.low: Brief, focused reasoning that moves straight to the conclusion.
thinkingHelp.medium: The model's own default: it reasons, with no instruction steering how much.
thinkingHelp.high: Works through the task carefully, checks assumptions and weighs alternatives. Slowest.

context.title: Context
context.lengthHelp: Token capacity reserved at load time
context.gpuLayersHelp: 999 offloads as many layers as fit
context.promptCacheDiskHelp: Conversations are written to disk in the background as they grow, a block at a time and only what changed (a few hundred MB, never the whole state at once), and read back when they return, so their prompt is not processed again: a 79K-token conversation comes back in about 4 seconds instead of 97 seconds of prefill. While there is room they also stay in their slots, so switching between conversations is immediate. Survives restarts. Applies on the next load.
context.promptCacheDiskMibHelp: How much the folder above may hold before the oldest conversation is removed. A long conversation of this model is several GB, so 16384 keeps about three of them; raise it if the drive has room.

speculative.title: Speculative decoding
speculative.noDraft: No MTP draft found beside the model, so MTP is off. Put Unsloth's mtp-Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-shared-Q4_K_M.gguf in the model's folder and rescan: decode is about 60% faster with it.
speculative.draftHelp: Only files under the registered model directories are listed. Decode is another 5–9% faster with the draft head from the releases page (mtp-…-head-iq4_xs.gguf, 349 MB): put it in the model's folder and rescan, and it is combined with the shared draft and preferred automatically.
speculative.draftMaxHelp: 3 is fastest here; longer drafts cost more than they return
speculative.draftMinHelp: Confidence below which drafting stops. Acceptance rules are unchanged.

vision.title: Image input
vision.help: Loads the vision projector so chats can include images. With it off, requests carrying an image are rejected.
vision.cost: Uses about 904 MB of GPU memory. Decode speed, prompt caching and MTP drafting are unaffected.
vision.noProjector: No vision projector (mmproj-F16.gguf) beside the model, so image input is off. Put it in the model's folder and rescan to turn it on.

advanced.note: Defaults are the measured best for this machine. Change these only to work around a specific problem.
advanced.ubatchHelp: Not larger than Batch. Larger batches use more memory and are not always faster.
advanced.parallelHelp: Requests served at once. Several slots share one context pool (a single conversation can still use all of it) and cost about 1 GB more than one slot; image input needs a single slot.
advanced.ngramHelp: Drafts by matching earlier text. Useful when MTP is off; alongside MTP it competes for the same verification budget and is usually slower.
advanced.ngramPending: Not yet applied. Reload the model after saving.

config.footer: Saving does not interrupt an ongoing chat. To apply new parameters, unload the model and load it again.
